jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Payments
jobs.location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is creating the best rent payment experience. It’s hard to believe that it’s 2026 and paying rent on time is expensive, inflexible, and difficult. We’re here to change that! Flex enables our users to pay rent throughout the month on a schedule that better fits their finances and budget. Our mission is to empower as many renters as possible with flexibility over their most significant recurring expense. After deliberately keeping a stealth profile as we built up unprecedented investor support and an enthusiastic user base, we are looking for motivated individuals to help us keep our mission growing. Will you be a part of the team?

About the Role

We're hiring a Principal Product Manager, Payments  to lead one of the most critical areas of our infrastructure: how money flows in and out of Flex. You will oversee our end-to-end payments platform - including transaction processing, payment-related fraud and disputes - and ensure it evolves into a strategic growth and margin lever.

This role is ideal for someone who thinks in platforms and systems, understands payment mechanics, and knows how to balance user experience, risk, and cost. You’ll work closely with Platform and Risk leadership to drive innovation and performance across payment rails, dispute automation, and fraud prevention, while enabling seamless user experiences and future expansion.

What you’ll do

- Shape the cross-functional platform product strategy . Map how future products fit together into a coherent architecture, and help ensure they’re built with speed and stability in mind.

- Own Flex’s payments platform strategy and roadmap end-to-end: vaulting, authorization, processing, reconciliation, and refunds across all payment methods (card, wallet, ACH).

- Drive down payment processing costs through better routing, smarter retry logic, and fraud/dispute efficiency - without sacrificing UX or resilience.

- Build and scale fraud detection and dispute infrastructure to reduce losses while minimizing false positives and user friction.

- Expand our payment method coverage , ensuring all channels (cards, bank transfers, wallets) are supported with the right controls, guardrails, and visibility.

- Partner with Risk, Finance, Ops, and Engineering to align on business goals and build resilient, compliant, and scalable payment solutions.

- Lead and grow a high-performing product team , coaching PMs while maintaining a strong bar for ownership and quality.

- Define success metrics and build dashboards, tooling, and processes to measure performance across cost, reliability, speed, and loss rates.

- Champion clear thinking, technical depth, and rigorous prioritization in a fast-moving, high-volume environment.

Key qualifications

- 7+ years of product experience, with at least 3+ years in payments, fraud, or platform product roles at a fintech, bank, or B2B2C fintech products.

- Deep understanding of the payments ecosystem: authorization, retries, tokenization, payment gateways, fraud systems, and card networks.

- Demonstrated ability to balance user experience, cost optimization, fraud risk, and regulatory requirements in product decisions.

- Strong technical acumen and systems thinking - you’ve worked closely with engineers to design reliable, scalable systems.

- Proven success as a player-coach: you’ve managed PMs and enjoy mentoring while rolling up your sleeves when needed.

- Bonus: Experience working with Payment processors, building dispute automation, or expanding payment options in regulated environments.

Compensation

Flex takes a market-based approach to pay, ensuring compensation is commensurate with a candidate's experience and our internal leveling guidelines. For candidates located in our Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area) markets, the base salary pay range for this role is below. Flex utilizes a geographic pay differential based on a cost of labor index. If you are located outside of the cities listed below, your starting pay will be adjusted to align with the market conditions of your specific geographic zone. Please speak with your recruiter for additional information regarding the specific range for your location.

Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area)
$248,000 — $310,000 USD

Life at Flex

We understand that it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self aware people to grow a successful company. Our HQ is located in New York City, but we have employees located throughout the US, Australia, Canada and South America. We are growing quickly, but deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.

Offices

Roles posted in New York, San Francisco, and Salt Lake City are hybrid positions with on-site expectations of 2-3 days per week in our local offices. For candidates outside of these areas, you may be eligible for our relocation assistance program.

Benefits

For full-time U.S. employees we offer:

- Competitive medical, dental, and vision

- Company equity

- 401(k) plan with company match

- Unlimited paid time off + 13 company paid holidays

- Parental leave

- Free Flex subscription

For full-time non-U.S. employees, we offer:

- Competitive compensation + company equity

- Unlimited PTO

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Partnerships
jobs.location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is creating the best rent payment experience. It’s hard to believe that it’s 2026 and paying rent on time is expensive, inflexible, and difficult. We’re here to change that! Flex enables our users to pay rent throughout the month on a schedule that better fits their finances and budget. Our mission is to empower as many renters as possible with flexibility over their most significant recurring expense. After deliberately keeping a stealth profile as we built up unprecedented investor support and an enthusiastic user base, we are looking for motivated individuals to help us keep our mission growing. Will you be a part of the team?

About the Role

This is a role for an exceptional product partnerships operator. The mandate is to unlock enterprise value in direct support of Product, Risk, and Finance strategic priorities: building the deepest understanding at Flex of the capability landscape — who does what, at what economics, and where the market is headed — and converting that insight into new capabilities, new commercial relationships, and best-in-class terms on the agreements that drive Flex's unit economics. The portfolio spans payment networks, payment processors, credit bureaus, data providers, and any capability partner that is highly strategic or has a major impact on Flex's unit economics.

You'll own the full partner lifecycle — from opportunity identification through negotiation, integration, launch, and portfolio optimization — along with the most senior relationships with Flex's key partners, setting Flex up for strong long-term growth. This is also a zero-to-one build: you will stand up the Product Partnerships function — the strategy, the playbooks, and, as the portfolio scales, the team. This role reports to the SVP of Business Development & Strategic Partnerships.

What You'll Do

Own the strategy that unlocks enterprise value

- Develop and maintain the deepest understanding at Flex of the capability landscape — providers, economics, emerging entrants, and market shifts — across payments, money movement, credit and bureau data, identity, risk, and data

- Partner with Product, Risk, and Business leadership to understand their strategic priorities — then map Flex's capability stack against gaps, margin opportunities, and strategic risk, and drive clear build-buy-partner decisions

- Identify and execute on the partnership opportunities that unlock enterprise value — new product surface area, stronger risk capabilities, better economics, or durable strategic advantage

- Build the business cases — unit economics modeling, market sizing, competitive analysis, and risk assessment — that earn executive conviction and cross-functional investment

- Pressure-test opportunities quickly and kill the ones that don't clear the bar, so the team's energy concentrates on the biggest levers

Negotiate best-in-class terms

- Lead complex, multi-stakeholder negotiations with payment networks, processors, credit bureaus, data providers, and other strategic capability partners

- Structure creative economics — incentive agreements, volume commitments, tiered pricing, revenue shares, and exclusivity mechanics — while protecting Flex's flexibility and long-term optionality

- Own the full deal cycle from thesis to term sheet to executed contract, in tight partnership with Legal, Finance, and Product

- Run renewals and renegotiations with the same rigor as new deals: benchmark the market, model the alternatives, and negotiate from a position of prepared leverage

Own the partner relationships that power long-term growth

- Own the most senior relationships with Flex's key partners across the portfolio — building the executive trust and multi-year strategic alignment that earn Flex preferential terms, early access to new capabilities, and durable advantage

- Partner closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to translate agreement terms and partner capabilities into product roadmaps, integration plans, and launch-ready experiences

- Define success metrics for each partnership, instrument them, and own the operating cadence — QBRs, performance reviews, escalation paths — that keeps partners delivering against their commitments

- Monitor portfolio health continuously: economics versus model, performance versus SLA, and capability versus an evolving competitive landscape

Build the machine, not just the wins

- Stand up the Product Partnerships function from zero to one — the operating model, the playbooks, and, as the portfolio scales, the team you hire and lead

- Create repeatable playbooks for evaluating, negotiating, launching, and managing product partnerships across their full lifecycle

- Report portfolio economics, pipeline health, forecasts, and strategic priorities to executive leadership

- Serve as a connective-tissue leader across BD, Product, Design, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and Risk & Compliance

Key Qualifications

- 12+ years of experience spanning product partnerships, business development, product management, or corporate development — ideally in fintech, payments, credit, or platform technology companies

- Fluent in the economics of at least one major capability domain — payments (interchange, network incentives, processing costs), credit and bureau data, or data infrastructure — and a fast study across the rest: you know where margin and leverage live, and how to negotiate for them

- A track record of negotiating complex agreements with networks, processors, bureaus, financial institutions, or major data providers, and carrying them through integration and launch to measurable P&L impact

- Demonstrated success identifying a new capability or commercial relationship before it was obvious — powered by a deep, current map of the provider ecosystem — and driving the cross-functional execution that captured the value

- A proven team builder and leader — you have hired, developed, and led high-performing teams, and you're equally effective operating hands-on as a function of one while the team takes shape

- Fluent collaborator with Product, Engineering, Risk, and Finance — you can engage credibly on APIs, integration scope, underwriting requirements, and unit economics, and you know how to earn the trust of technical and analytical teams

- Commercially creative with strong financial rigor: comfortable building the model, stress-testing the assumptions, and defending it to a CFO

- An exceptional relationship-builder with a track record of owning C-suite and senior executive relationships at strategic partners — and converting that trust into better terms, earlier access, and long-term growth

- Thrive in ambiguity and high-velocity environments; equally strong at strategic thinking and hands-on execution

- Excellent communicator and storyteller — able to turn analysis into narrative and narrative into organizational momentum

- Disciplined operator with strong portfolio management and forecasting instincts

- Deeply curious about financial technology, payments, credit, and the rental ecosystem

Compensation

The compensation range for this role will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and Flex's internal leveling guidelines and benchmarks. This is a commission earning role. The OTE (On Target Earnings) listed below:

OTE (NYC/Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle)
$285,000 — $350,000 USD

OTE (Salt Lake City, all other USA cities)
$245,000 — $305,000 USD

We understand that it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self aware people to grow a successful company. Our HQ is located in New York City, but we have employees located throughout the US, Australia, Canada and South America. We are growing quickly, but deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.

Offices

Roles posted in New York, San Francisco, and Salt Lake City are hybrid positions with on-site expectations of 2-3 days per week in our local offices. For candidates outside of these areas, you may be eligible for our relocation assistance program.

Benefits

For full-time U.S. employees we offer:

- Competitive medical, dental, and vision

- Company equity

- 401(k) plan with company match

- Unlimited paid time off + 13 company paid holidays

Reporting to the CPO and working in a close partnership with the General Manager of our Bills division, you will be product owner for this rapidly growing business. Your mandate will be to scale a new product offering from early market fit to a major business line, operating with the autonomy of a startup and the resources of an established market leader.

Core Responsibilities

- Product Strategy & Execution: Define the product strategy and roadmap for Bills. Own the product lifecycle from concept to launch and scale. Translate ambiguous, high-level strategic concepts into a coherent product vision and a prioritized, metrics-driven roadmap.

- Discovery & Validation Framework: Establish and lead the process for continuous customer discovery, rapid prototyping, and data driven validation. Ensure the team is relentlessly focused on solving the right problems and validating assumptions before scaling.

- Executive Partnership & Communication: Serve as the primary product owner for Bills. You will be responsible for communicating the product strategy, roadmap, progress, and risks effectively to the executive team and other senior stakeholders.

- Metrics & Goal Ownership: Define and own the key product metrics for the new venture. You will hold a high degree of accountability for achieving both product and commercial targets, demonstrating a strong P&L orientation.

- Team Leadership & Development: Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing, dedicated team of senior IC product managers. Foster a culture of rapid experimentation, deep customer discovery, and high accountability.

Qualifications

- Extensive Leadership Experience: 10+ years in product management, with at least 4-5 years in a leadership role (Director or Sr. Director) managing other product managers.

- Proven Track Record of Scaling Products: You have a clear, demonstrable history of leading a product team to scale early stage products from initial MVP to a validated, growing business line.

- Strong Executive Presence: Proven ability to communicate and influence at the highest levels. You must have experience presenting complex strategies, trade-offs, and results to C-level leadership.

- Talent Magnet: A demonstrated ability to hire, manage, and develop senior-level product talent.

- Thrives in Ambiguity: You are comfortable and effective operating with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus Qualifications

- Previous experience as a founder or co-founder.

- Experience in FinTech or PropTech

- Have scaled prior new product lines within a startup or growth company
